Price moderately elevated (~$50/bbl) ahead of the meeting. Markets largely priced in the expected cut before the announcement, explaining the -11% price_change_pct (buy the rumor, sell the news effect). Sources: EIA STEO June 2017; Reuters May 2017.

event: 2018-05-08 US withdraws from Iran nuclear deal (JCPOA) — Iran sanctions re-imposed
notes: Highest possible sanctions signal — Trump explicitly telegraphed JCPOA withdrawal for months. Media coverage intense in the week before announcement. No shipping incidents pre-event. event: 2020-04-12 OPEC+ historic 9.7 mb/d production cut agreed
notes: Largest coordinated cut in history — G20 energy ministers involved. Zero sanctions signal. Extreme media coverage in days before (G20 energy meeting April 10). Market-dominated event; price and news signals maximal. Sources: IEA OMR April 2020; EIA; FT.
